About me

I finished a Higher National Diploma in Network and Security at IUG in 2025, then a Professional Bachelor's in Network Administrator and Security in 2026. Between and after those studies I interned twice in the Network and Telecommunications department of DISI / DASI, a major utility company.

What keeps me interested is the moment a design holds up under testing: a failover that actually fails over, a VLAN that actually isolates. I like designing infrastructure that is secure, reliable and able to grow, and I write documentation as I go because the next person has to run it.

I'm looking for a junior network or security role where I can keep learning on real infrastructure. I work in English and French.
